verdict.rationale: Convex explicitly separates dev and production deployments (docs-6/17/18), and its MCP server is documented as blocked from production access by default 'to prevent accidental modifications to production data' (docs-28), directly supporting safe sandbox testing for AI agents. Self-hosting options (docs-8/19/30) further allow isolated environments for testing. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that dev deployments fully mirror production schema/data for realistic testing, and no explicit mention of seeded or reset sandbox datasets for repeatable AI testing
